title: Playboy Magazine October 1987 Back to Campus Donna Mills Richard Secord
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal storage and handling wear; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, October 1987 - Back to Campus Issue. Cover price $3.50.

Features:
- The Women of the Top Ten Party Schools
- Pigskin Preview: who's going to win in college football?
- Patriot or Pirate? A fighting interview with General Richard Secord
- Donna Mills makes a smash landing
- Star Appeal: who plays the charity circuit?

NOTE ON THE PHOTOS: this issue is at BOTTOM RIGHT in the group photo and SECOND FROM BOTTOM in the stack.
